patterns: APPSC asks one-line identifications: Ramsar = wetlands, CITES = endangered species trade (Washington Convention), Nagoya = part of CBD, IUCN full form, International Year of Biodiversity 2010.
Recent APPSC items probe definitions (Nagoya 'utilization of genetic resources' = R&D on genetic/biochemical composition) and CA conferences (CMS COP14 Samarkand 2024).
AP tilt: Kolleru Lake as AP's Ramsar site; red sanders (Seshachalam) under CITES App II.
Other PSCs test GEF facts, Montreux Record meaning, Cartagena = biosafety (MoEF nodal), UN Decade on Biodiversity 2011-20.
App MCQs go much deeper (KMGBF target numbers, finance figures, CoP20 listings, NBSAP counts) mostly as statement/match items; PYQs stay at name-subject-year level.
